theme: local file/state workspace bootstrap: SYS MKDIR + JOIN + BASENAME under STATE/TMP

tests.name: state_auto_mkdir
tests.note: SYS MKDIR creates STATE + runs/<id>/{in,out,log}; RUN_MANIFEST.txt

tests.name: mkdir_on_file_strict_sticky
tests.cmd: WRITE file; MKDIR same path; PASS; no CLEAR_ERR; run -q -s
tests.note: last_err mkdir: not a directory; err_line=0; rc=1

weaknesses.title: SYS JOIN missing from forms and search
weaknesses.detail: Proofs and plate_workspace use SYS JOIN for path build, but cubalc forms JOIN and search join return n=0. Agents discover MKDIR/TMP/BASENAME in forms but invent SYS CAT glue or fail to find JOIN — same class of invisible string plane as earlier SYS CAT gap.
weaknesses.repro: ./out/cubalc forms JOIN → n=0; ./out/cubalc search join → n=0

weaknesses.title: SYS MKDIR failure soft with err_line=0 empty err_src
weaknesses.detail: MKDIR on an existing file sets OK=0 sticky last_err='mkdir: not a directory' but does not hard-stop; run plate ok can still be true without -s. err_line=0 err_src empty. Under -s, PASS without CLEAR_ERR fails process with no source line. Agents cannot distinguish mkdir soft from other soft errs by line.
weaknesses.repro: SYS WRITE path "x"; SYS MKDIR path; run -q -s without CLEAR_ERR

weaknesses.title: SYS JOIN is 2-arg only; multi-segment needs nested JOIN
weaknesses.detail: SYS JOIN a b c parse-errors on leftover 'c'. Building root/runs/id/out requires four JOINs. Ugly for agents vs shell path join of N parts.

weaknesses.title: DIRNAME/BASENAME trailing-slash quirks
weaknesses.detail: SYS DIRNAME "/a/b/" yields "/a" (length 2) not "/a/b"; BASENAME "/a/b/" yields "b". Trailing slashes from JOIN mistakes silently peel wrong component — agents need path normalize form.

weaknesses.title: MKDIR soft fail does not set plate exit_code
weaknesses.detail: Like other soft host errs: process may be 0 without -s while last_err set; exit_code stays 0. Workspace bootstrap CI should use -s or ASSERT OK after MKDIR.
weaknesses.repro: mkdir-on-file run without -s → shell 0, last_err set

weaknesses.title: PRINT still length-only for path strings
weaknesses.detail: Debugging JOIN/BASENAME still needs PRINT_JSON/VARS; PRINT run_dir shows length. Ongoing agent UX gap.

workarounds: SYS MKDIR STATE (or root) before any WRITE under CUBALC_STATE — no shell mkdir required when MKDIR works
Nested SYS JOIN for multi-segment paths; avoid 3+ args
ASSERT OK == 1 or CLEAR_ERR after every MKDIR when using run -s
Strip trailing slashes before DIRNAME/BASENAME if host paths are messy
Rely on forms for MKDIR/TMP/BASENAME; hardcode SYS JOIN knowledge until cataloged
PRINT_JSON path vars instead of PRINT
language_gaps: Catalog SYS JOIN (and CAT) in forms/search
SYS JOIN multi-arg or path builder for N segments
Hard-fail option for MKDIR (ASSERT-style) vs soft default
Optional SYS STATE FILE name one-shot under STATE after MKDIR
